value.rationale: On the natural minimal class of coupled directed feedback rings, exact periodic-orbit multiplicities and individual attraction basins quantitatively characterize interference from two incoming gates. The arithmetic gcd of the ring lengths and bridge separation precisely controls all recurrence/basin statistics. The explicit offsets \((a,b,s)=(8,8,1),(8,8,2),(8,8,4)\) give 2207,2209,2401 phases, while the nonzero downstream survival probability tends to one for equal growing ring lengths and to zero if the downstream ring is lengthened by one. These are structural, not arbitrary isolated numerical slices.
